# Windows' answers about this computer's disks, in the form
# faraday_hub_shell::windows::disks::Snapshot::parse reads, made by hand
# to the documented layouts of STORAGE_DEVICE_DESCRIPTOR,
# DISK_GEOMETRY_EX, DRIVE_LAYOUT_INFORMATION_EX and VOLUME_DISK_EXTENTS
# (x86_64). `faraday-starter --record-disks` on a Windows computer prints the
# same form. The makers, models, serials and volume names are made up.
windows C:\Windows
system-partition \Device\HarddiskVolume1
page-file \??\C:\pagefile.sys
#
# Disk 0: the computer's own NVMe disk, with the EFI system partition
# and Windows.
disk 0

  geometry 34f30000000000000c000000ff0000003f000000000200000060253c77000000
  layout

  geometry 9a070000000000000b000000ff0000003f00000000020000000030ba03000000
  layout
